title: Guardianship of Hindu minors is governed primarily by the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956 (HMGA)

content.overview: Guardianship of Hindu minors is governed primarily by the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956 (HMGA). Section 6 names the natural guardians of the person and separate property (excluding undivided interest in joint family property): for a boy or unmarried girl — the father, and after him the mother (with ordinary custody of a child under five with the mother); for an illegitimate child — the mother, and after her the father; for a married girl — the husband. No person who has ceased to be a Hindu or who has renounced the world may act as natural guardian. Section 8 restricts the natural guardian’s power to deal with the minor’s property and requires prior court permission for specified transfers. Section 13 makes the welfare of the minor the paramount consideration. Court-appointed guardians are governed by the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890.
